review:
A crime story on the Vegas Strip, 5x3. Dead Presidents Nudge fires when a premium lands fully on one of the first three reels, pulling matching pieces into view. A three-row xNudge wild always nudges into view, +1 multiplier per nudge.

Two scatters give a dice respin that turns them into x2 and x3 overlay multipliers; three give nine VEGA$ Spins with x2, x3 and x4 overlays. xSplit shows up too. High volatility, 10,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
